data.gender_notes: Shohidul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shohidul is a powerful name that signifies victory, bravery, and courage. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shohda' which means 'victorious'. This name is perfect for parents who wish to instill a sense of strength and determination in their child. The name Shohidul carries the meaning “Victorious, Brave, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Bengali, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shohidul usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, brave, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shohidul is a divine name that represents the victory of the soul over the material world. It is believed that those bearing this name have a strong spiritual connection and are blessed with the courage to overcome any obstacle in life.
data.etymology: Shohidul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Brave, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shohidul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference:
Shohidul Chaudhuri (1917-1996) was a prominent Indian film and television actor.
He acted in various Bengali language films and television serials.
He gained popularity with his role as 'Panchanan' in the serial 'Golpo Holeo Satti', which was aired from 1975 to 1987.

Shohidul Islam (1786-1841) was a renowned Bengali poet and scholar.
He was a disciple of the famous poet and philosopher, Ramprasad Sen.
He wrote several works on various religious and philosophical topics, one of which is 'Shohidul-Nam', where he expressed his devotion towards God.
